questions.passage: Barry Commoner, born in Brooklyn in 1917, was the son of Jewish __________ (immigrate) from Russia. Commoner was a leading ecologist and one of the founders of the modern environmental movement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 'the son of Jewish __________(유대계 ~의 아들)'에서 of 뒤에는 명사가 필요해요. 동사 immigrate(이주하다)를 '이주해 온 사람들'을 뜻하는 명사 immigrants(이민자들)로 바꿔요. 러시아에서 온 이민자들의 아들이라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: immigrate(동사) → immigrant(명사). 'the son of immigrants(이민자들의 아들)'라 복수형 immigrants

questions.passage: In 1980, Commoner founded the Citizens Party to serve as a vehicle for his ecological message. In his later years, Commoner continued his efforts to raise __________ (aware) about the impact that human activity has on the environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 raise(높이다)의 목적어 자리라 명사가 필요해요. 형용사 aware(알고 있는)를 명사 awareness(인식·자각)로 바꿔요. 'raise awareness(인식을 높이다)'는 자주 쓰는 표현이에요.
det.tip: aware(형용사) → awareness(명사). 'raise awareness(인식을 높이다)' 통째로 외우기

questions.passage: Barry Commoner, born in Brooklyn in 1917, was the son of Jewish immigrants from Russia. Commoner was a leading ecologist and one of the founders of __________. He earned his doctoral degree in cellular biology from Harvard University in 1941. After serving in the US Navy during World War II, Commoner moved to Missouri, and became a professor of plant physiology at Washington University in 1947, where he taught for 34 years. In the late 1950s, Commoner became widely known for his opposition to nuclear weapons testing and went on to write several books about the negative ecological effects of atmospheric nuclear testing. In 1980, Commoner founded the Citizens Party to serve as a vehicle for his ecological message. In his later years, Commoner continued his efforts to raise awareness about the impact that human activity has on the environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선도적 생태학자가 창시자였던 것 → '현대 환경 운동'(the modern environmental movement)
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'a leading ecologist and one of the founders of __________'가 단서예요. 선도적 '생태학자'가 창시자였으니 빈칸은 '환경 운동'이어야 자연스러워요.

✅ ① the modern environmental movement(현대 환경 운동): 생태학자·환경 맥락과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② a famous Russian theater group(유명한 러시아 극단): 러시아는 부모의 출신지일 뿐, 극단과 무관
❌ ③ a small local sports club(작은 지역 스포츠 클럽): 생태학과 관계없음
❌ ④ an ancient religious tradition(고대 종교 전통): 문맥에 맞지 않음
det.tip: leading ecologist(선도적 생태학자) → environmental movement(환경 운동)의 창시자
